# Test font fixtures

`Syncopate-Regular.ttf` is from [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Syncopate),
licensed under the Apache License 2.0. It is committed here so that
`readFamilyName` and the font-supply tests run against a real sfnt file rather
than a hand-built approximation, and so the suite needs no network.

Copyright the Syncopate Project Authors. See
<https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/apache/syncopate/LICENSE.txt>.

No other font is redistributed by this repository. Families fetched at runtime
are downloaded to the user's cache and carry their own licences.
